title: The timeline bar Easing sets picked segments too when keys are picked with them
goal: When a person Shift-picks some keys and some segments of the line together and chooses an ease in the timeline bar, only the keys change today; the mock says the bar sets the curve for everything picked, so the segments should take it as well, in one undo step.
notes: Left from the-value-graph-zooms-its-value-range-and-the-ti. Today TimelineDock.keyBar shows the per-key KeyEase list whenever keySelection.refs is non-empty, and the shared EasingCurve list (CurveRow.menu) only for segments alone. Mixing needs a decision on how a key ease and a segment curve combine: a segment curve rewrites the leaving half of its first key and the arriving half of its last (LayerMotion.curvingStretch), so applying both in one perform can fight. Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-animate.html, Pick caption: The timeline bar Easing then names the curve and sets it for everything picked.
acceptance: With keys and segments picked together, the bar names one shared answer or Mixed
Choosing an ease there changes the picked keys and the picked segments, one undo step
A walk picks a key and a segment together and sets both from the bar at Next defaults
